basis.J4: the battery interface is a MANUAL wire-solder operation, not an SMT placement: BATTERY_HARNESS freezes rear insertion and front-side barrel-fill inspection, and a pick-and-place row for it would be an instruction to fit a connector that is not fitted.
basis.LS1: PUI AS02008MR-LW152-R, a 20 mm 8 ohm speaker on 152 mm flying leads that mates to J6.  It is FITTED in the product, shipped on aqroot-Demo-OFF-BOARD.csv, and is not a board footprint.
basis.test_points: a test point is a bare copper land with no component to place; it exists for probing and rework and has no pick-and-place row.

POP5.why: POP1-POP4 are all about the DNP FLAG.  None of them asks whether a reference the schematic marks FITTED exists on the board at all, so deleting a fitted footprint left this contract green while land_parity failed (R11-08).  Every exemption is declared and is checked in BOTH directions, so a stale declaration refuses as loudly as an undeclared absence.
